reasonForIsolation: Working-tree submission protocol was being updated concurrently; original archived prompt and pre-submission supervisor/action gate/proxy were retained in the private source snapshot, leaving those concurrent changes untouched.

runtimeInstrumentation.Appium: RecordingProxy records existing request boundaries and response bytes in memory, flushed after the episode; no extra observation requests.

runtimeInstrumentation.NewDeviceObservations: None introduced by diagnostic recorder. Ownership preflight is separately timestamped.
